mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 59 degrees with overcast skies at Verona Community Park and the moon is in its third quarter phase.

City news this week includes a reminder that winter parking regulations start November 20 to help with snow removal, and the Verona Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.

There is plenty to do today with live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus the Dane County Farmers Market happening at the Capitol. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness on November 2, and trivia nights are returning to Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's on November 4.
In our weekly report, officers handled a variety of calls, including an incident on October 25 where a driver was arrested for an O W I after being found stopped at an intersection for 20 minutes.
You can enjoy today's flavor, Mint Explosion, at Culver's, which is currently open and serving guests until 10:30 PM tonight.
